participation.context: Answered on the second naming, and left the line to follow him home.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Said his name twice, and took him out of the wind.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Named the four parts, and told him a song is not a sermon.
participation.name: Thomas Morley

participation.context: Said he had reached the second of the four last things, and sent them to eat.
participation.name: Master Josias Thwaite

participation.context: Passed out of his pew without sword-bearer or halberds, and looked at nobody.
participation.name: Sir John Spencer

story.body: You stood in the porch fitting a line to the anthem and missed your name. Mistress Ansell asked if you were unwell or only a poet. Morley told you to keep the chord and to write the boys short open lines. Thwaite had got as far as judgment. Spencer had already gone, looking at nobody. You went home at her heel.
